knowledge:
- key_parameters: method=In estimate.mean.fraglen, specifies the method to estimate fragment length (e.g., "correlation") ;; width=In resize, the fixed length to extend reads (e.g., 200) ;; lower=In slice, the minimum coverage threshold to define islands or peaks (e.g., lower = 1 for islands, lower = 8 for peaks) ;; fdr=In peakCutoff, the false discovery rate used to estimate peak cutoff (e.g., 0.0001)
- alternatives: ShortRead::readAligned is used for reading raw alignments, but modern workflows often use GenomicAlignments::readGAlignments. External aligners like MAQ are used prior to R analysis.
- when_to_use: Use this package when performing basic downstream analysis of ChIP-Seq data (such as transcription factor binding site identification) starting from aligned short reads.
- pitfalls: Duplicate reads, non-canonical chromosomes, and low-quality alignments should be filtered out first (using chipseqFilter and quality filters) to avoid noise. Fragment length estimation (estimate.mean.fraglen) might return NA for some chromosomes, so filtering !is.na(fraglen) is necessary. Out-of-bound ranges can occur when flanking genomic regions near chromosome boundaries.

workflows.name: chipseq_analysis_and_differential_peaks
workflows.intent: Perform ChIP-seq read extension, coverage calculation, peak calling, differential peak analysis between two samples, and genomic context annotation.
input: sampleFiles (aligned sequence files, e.g., BAM or export files)
workflows.stages: 1. Filter and load aligned reads using chipseqFilter and ShortRead ;; 2. Estimate fragment length using estimate.mean.fraglen ;; 3. Extend reads to estimated fragment length using resize ;; 4. Calculate coverage using coverage ;; 5. Identify islands and analyze depth using slice, viewSums, viewMaxs, and islandDepthPlot ;; 6. Determine peak cutoff using peakCutoff and call peaks using slice ;; 7. Summarize peaks using peakSummary ;; 8. Plot strand-specific coverage using coverageplot ;; 9. Perform differential peak analysis using diffPeakSummary ;; 10. Annotate peaks with genomic features (promoters, genes) using GenomicFeatures and %over%
workflows.code:
filter <- compose(chipseqFilter(), alignQualityFilter(15))
cstest <- GenomicRangesList(lapply(sampleFiles, function(file) {
  as(readAligned(file, filter), "GRanges")
}))
cstest <- cstest[seqnames(cstest) %in% c("chr10", "chr11", "chr12")]

fraglen <- estimate.mean.fraglen(cstest$ctcf, method="correlation")
fraglen[!is.na(fraglen)] 

ctcf.ext <- resize (cstest$ctcf, width = 200)

cov.ctcf <- coverage(ctcf.ext)

islands <- slice(cov.ctcf, lower = 1)

viewSums(islands)
viewMaxs(islands)

nread.tab <- table(viewSums(islands) / 200)
depth.tab <- table(viewMaxs(islands))

islandDepthPlot(cov.ctcf)

peakCutoff(cov.ctcf, fdr = 0.0001) 

peaks.ctcf <- slice(cov.ctcf, lower = 8) 

peaks <- peakSummary(peaks.ctcf) 

peak.depths <- viewMaxs(peaks.ctcf)

cov.pos <- coverage(ctcf.ext[strand(ctcf.ext) == "+"]) 
cov.neg <- coverage(ctcf.ext[strand(ctcf.ext) == "-"])

peaks.pos <- Views(cov.pos, ranges(peaks.ctcf)) 
peaks.neg <- Views(cov.neg, ranges(peaks.ctcf))

wpeaks <- tail(order(peak.depths$chr10), 4)

coverageplot(peaks.pos$chr10[wpeaks[1]], peaks.neg$chr10[wpeaks[1]])

cov.gfp <- coverage(resize(cstest$gfp, 200))
peaks.gfp <- slice(cov.gfp, lower = 8)

peakSummary <- diffPeakSummary(peaks.gfp, peaks.ctcf)

mcols(peakSummary) <- 
    within(mcols(peakSummary), 
       {
           diffs <- asinh(sums2) - asinh(sums1) 
           resids <- (diffs - median(diffs)) / mad(diffs) 
           up <- resids > 2 
           down <- resids < -2 
           change <- ifelse(up, "up", ifelse(down, "down", "flat")) 
       })

library(TxDb.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm9.knownGene) 
gregions <- transcripts(TxDb.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm9.knownGene) 

promoters <- flank(gregions, 1000, both = TRUE) 

peakSummary$inPromoter <- peakSummary %over% promoters
xtabs(~ inPromoter + change, peakSummary) 

peakSummary$inUpstream <- peakSummary %over% flank(gregions, 20000)
peakSummary$inGene <- peakSummary %over% gregions

sumtab <- 
    as.data.frame(rbind(total = xtabs(~ change, peakSummary),
                        promoter = xtabs(~ change, 
                          subset(peakSummary, inPromoter)),
                        upstream = xtabs(~ change, 
                          subset(peakSummary, inUpstream)),
                        gene = xtabs(~ change, subset(peakSummary, inGene))))
